fields.name: uiFont
fields.label: UI Font
fields.description: Used for navigation, buttons, labels, and general interface text.

fields.name: editorialFont
fields.label: Editorial Font
fields.description: Used for headings and editorial typography.

fields.name: bodyFontSize
fields.label: Body Font Size (px)
fields.description: Base site text size. Recommended range: 16–22.

fields.name: articleFontSize
fields.label: Article Font Size (px)
fields.description: Journal and long-form paragraph size. Recommended range: 18–26.

fields.name: headingScale
fields.label: Heading Scale
fields.description: Multiplier for headings. 1.0 is the current design; try 0.9–1.15.

fields.name: lineHeight
fields.label: Line Height
fields.description: Base line-height multiplier. Recommended range: 1.4–1.9.

fields.name: contentWidth
fields.label: Maximum Site Width (px)
fields.description: Maximum width for primary site containers.

fields.name: readingWidth
fields.label: Reading Column Width (px)
fields.description: Maximum width of long-form article text.

fields.name: backgroundColor
fields.label: Page Background
fields.description: CSS color, preferably a hex value.

fields.name: surfaceColor
fields.label: Surface Background
fields.description: Cards, menus, and secondary surfaces.

fields.name: elevatedColor
fields.label: Elevated Surface
fields.description: Higher-contrast elevated surfaces.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Topic Name
fields.description: Visible name. Rename this freely without changing the public URL.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Optional description used on the Topic archive page.

fields.name: active
fields.label: Active
fields.description: Retire a Topic instead of deleting it. Retired Topics disappear from new-entry selectors but remain valid on existing stories.

fields.name: replacement
fields.label: Replacement Topic
fields.description: Optional. For a retired duplicate, choose the Topic that should replace it. Old URLs and story references resolve to the replacement.

fields.name: slug
fields.label: Permanent URL Slug
fields.description: Stable lowercase URL value. Treat this as permanent after publication.

fields.name: aliases
fields.label: Previous URL Slugs
fields.description: Optional old slugs that must continue resolving after an intentional URL migration.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Section Name
fields.description: Public name. Change this freely; entries keep their stable section slug.

fields.name: slug
fields.label: Permanent Slug
fields.description: Stable value stored on Journal entries and used in the section URL.

fields.name: active
fields.label: Active
fields.description: Inactive sections disappear from Journal navigation; their stories fall back to Latest.

fields.name: aliases
fields.label: Previous Slugs
fields.description: Optional previous URLs that should continue resolving after a slug migration.

fields.name: navigation
fields.label: Main Navigation
fields.description: Drag to reorder. Add child links only when a top-level destination needs a submenu.

fields.name: page
fields.label: Internal Page
fields.description: Choose a Tina-managed page. Leave blank when using a custom or external URL.

fields.name: href
fields.label: Custom or External URL
fields.description: Use for fixed site routes or full external URLs. An internal-page selection takes priority when both are present.

fields.name: children
fields.label: Child Links
fields.description: Optional links shown in this item's submenu.

fields.name: page
fields.label: Internal Page
fields.description: Choose a Tina-managed page. Leave blank when using a custom or external URL.

fields.name: href
fields.label: Custom or External URL
fields.description: Use for fixed site routes or full external URLs. An internal-page selection takes priority when both are present.

fields.name: sectionOrder
fields.label: Homepage Section Order
fields.description: Drag the rows into place. The arrow buttons provide the same control from a keyboard.

fields.name: links
fields.label: Portfolio Destinations
fields.description: Add and drag the compact destination links shown on the Homepage.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Optional Image
fields.description: Shown behind the destination label. Leave blank for a simple text tile.

fields.name: journalPreview
fields.label: Journal Preview Section
fields.description: Featured story is managed under Journal Homepage and shared with this preview.

fields.name: titleHref
fields.label: Title Link
fields.description: Site path linked from the section title, such as /journal/.

fields.name: featuredEntry
fields.label: Featured Journal Story
fields.description: Shown on both the main homepage preview and Journal homepage. Leave blank to feature the newest published story. Draft or missing selections also fall back to the newest published story.

fields.name: body
fields.label: Page Content (Markdown)
fields.description: Write portable Markdown with the same editor used for Journal entries.

fields.name: path
fields.label: URL Path
fields.description: Lowercase path without a leading slash, such as portfolio/video.

fields.name: draft
fields.label: Draft
fields.description: Draft pages are saved in Git but do not receive a public route.

fields.name: blocks
fields.label: Page Blocks

fields.name: markdown
fields.label: Text (Markdown)
fields.description: Portable Markdown text. Use blank lines between paragraphs.

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Alt Text
fields.description: Describe meaningful images. Leave blank only when the image is decorative.

fields.name: url
fields.label: YouTube URL
fields.description: Paste a standard youtube.com, youtu.be, or YouTube embed URL.

fields.name: imageAltPrefix
fields.label: Image Alt Prefix
fields.description: Short description used before each image number, such as Event photo.

fields.name: paths
fields.label: Page Paths
fields.description: Add complete Custom Page paths without leading slashes, in the order the tiles should appear.

fields.name: tiles
fields.label: Bento Tiles
fields.description: Add and drag tiles into the order you want them to appear.

fields.name: internalPath
fields.label: Internal Custom Page Path
fields.description: Use a Custom Page path without a leading slash, such as tools/tire-thermal. If this resolves to a published Custom Page, it takes priority over the URL below.

fields.name: href
fields.label: Custom or External URL
fields.description: Use a site path or full external URL when the tile does not target another Custom Page.

fields.name: linkLabel
fields.label: Link Label
fields.description: Optional. Defaults to View.
Add, remove, and drag blocks to control the page order.

fields.name: body
fields.label: Legacy Page Content (Markdown)
fields.description: Existing Markdown remains supported and renders after Page Blocks. New modular page sections should use Page Blocks.

fields.name: body
fields.label: Entry Content (Markdown)
fields.description: Write portable Markdown. Use the toolbar for formatting, links, Immich/R2, managed/external images, and YouTube embeds.

fields.name: journalSection
fields.label: Journal Section
fields.description: Choose one active section, or leave blank for Latest only.

fields.name: commentsDisabled
fields.label: Disable Comments
fields.description: Hide the discussion and stop new comments on this entry after publishing. Leave off to allow moderated comments.

fields.name: draft
fields.label: Status
fields.description: Choose whether this story is public.

fields.name: tags
fields.label: Topics
fields.description: Choose what this story is about. Topics power related stories and topic archives. Add or retire Topics under Settings → Topics.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Short summary used on Journal cards and in search/social metadata.

fields.name: date
fields.label: Publication Date
fields.description: Defaults to today for new entries and controls Journal chronology.

fields.name: immichGallery
fields.label: Immich Gallery
fields.description: Display a live gallery from a public share.angrysquirrel.org album link.

description.value: References another document, used as a foreign key
